findings.highlight: …But Kotomine’s story is not something I can ignore.
findings.governingReading: an indistinct first fragment of Illya’s call interrupts Shirou’s thoughts
findings.explanation: mirror moon omits the first active half-heard call, removing one beat from the interruption buildup.

findings.highlight: I’m still surprised by how calm I was when I found out Kotomine was a Master.
findings.governingReading: a louder, still-unregistered fragment of Illya’s call interrupts again
findings.explanation: mirror moon omits the second active call fragment and allows the internal monologue to proceed without interruption.

findings.highlight: I’m still surprised by how calm I was
findings.evidenceJa: そうショックを受けなかった事が意外だった
findings.governingReading: he is surprised that Kirei’s disclosure did not shock him more deeply
findings.explanation: The degree of Shirou’s internal shock becomes his outward calm, contradicting the earlier startled reaction less precisely.

findings.evidenceJa: 心の何処かいや、もっと元始的なところで
findings.governingReading: somewhere in his heart—or at an even more primal level
findings.explanation: The self-correction from emotional intuition to something more primordial disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: あの男とは相容れない
findings.governingReading: he and that man are fundamentally incompatible
findings.explanation: Deep incompatibility is narrowed into being on opposing sides of a conflict.

findings.highlight: …In any case, Kotomine lost his Servant.
findings.governingReading: a third fragment, now nearing the end of Shirou’s name, interrupts the count
findings.explanation: mirror moon omits the third active call fragment and the escalation toward Illya’s intelligible shout.

findings.highlight: Assassin’s Master, who seems to be at the Ryuudou Temple
findings.evidenceJa: 柳洞寺に潜むというアサシンのマスター
findings.governingReading: the Master of Assassin, the Servant said to be lurking at Ryuudou Temple
findings.explanation: The temple-lurking modifier is attached to Assassin’s unseen Master instead of Assassin.

findings.highlight: Berserker’s Master, the girl in front of me right now!
findings.evidenceJa: 目の前の少女だけなんだけど！？
findings.governingReading: the only remaining one is the girl directly before him, Berserker’s Master
findings.explanation: The “only one” completion of the three-Master count disappears, weakening the comic collision between exposition and Illya’s arrival.

findings.evidenceJa: 耳鳴りらしきものがしてた
findings.governingReading: he had been hearing something like ringing in his ears
findings.explanation: The specific false interpretation that sets up recognition of Illya’s distant calls becomes an unspecified sound.

findings.highlight: You were walking with a difficult expression.
findings.evidenceJa: 難しい顔して歩いてる
findings.governingReading: he was walking with a troubled or serious expression
findings.explanation: A literal transfer produces unnatural English and obscures Illya’s awareness that he is preoccupied.

findings.highlight: We have a tacit understanding to meet there in the afternoon.
findings.evidenceJa: もう暗黙の了解になっていた筈だ
findings.governingReading: by now, their afternoon meetings there should have become an implicit understanding
findings.explanation: The “by now” development and Shirou’s qualified recollection disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: むー、と睨んでくるイリヤ
findings.governingReading: Illya glares at him with a sulky “muu”
findings.explanation: The childlike, visibly sulking quality of Illya’s anger is flattened into a generic glare.

findings.highlight: I have to show her my sincerity
findings.evidenceJa: 精一杯の誠意を見せて許してもらうしかない
findings.governingReading: his only option is to show the utmost sincerity and obtain her forgiveness
findings.explanation: mirror moon removes both the maximum effort and the explicit goal of being forgiven from the choice lead-in.
